title: Parapet cap finish approval
authority_policy: All project records and measurements are fictional. Owner follow-ups can authorize scope changes; supplier and surveyor statements alone cannot. An owner-approved survey defines the quantity when explicitly adopted. Later dates alone do not establish supersession. Draft proposals are complete only to the extent their text says so. Evaluate documentary consistency, not design safety or code compliance.

source_context.use: Factual paraphrase of a guide specification, not a project requirement unless adopted in synthetic records.

paragraphs.text: The early elevation calls for a bronze finish on the new aluminum parapet caps.
Two finish chips were viewed outdoors. The owner requested a darker sample but did not select it during the visit.
Sample request A: supply a charcoal chip for comparison; retain bronze in the working schedule until I confirm.
Approval B: use charcoal on all new parapet caps instead of bronze. This supersedes the elevation finish note only; aluminum material and cap extent stay unchanged.
New aluminum parapet caps over the unchanged extent, charcoal finish per Approval B.
